test_title: PYST 53: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate degree to fill in the blank.

Doctors should never be _________ than others when patients come for their treatment.
solution:
The correct answer is '**less caring**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• Doctors should always maintain a high level of care and empathy while treating patients. 
 
• The word "**less caring**" is appropriate as the sentence emphasizes that doctors should not show lower levels of care. 
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **3** do not fit the required context of the sentence. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Doctors should never be **less caring**__ than others when patients come for their treatment."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "least caring"** is incorrect because it suggests the minimum level of care, which is not suitable for doctors. 
 
• **Option 2: "more caring"** is incorrect because the sentence does not compare levels of care positively. 
 
• **Option 3: "most caring"** is incorrect as it suggests the highest level of care, which does not fit the negative comparison implied.
